body:
Founder screenshot: 'it lost the names of the materials and still looks a bit off.' Root cause: the previous alignment fix nested the name span 3 flex levels deep with truncate applied at the innermost level, which needs a definite width the nesting never reliably gave it -- collapsed to invisible. Flattened to <li> as a simple column: title row (name + Delete) then hint line below, no multi-level flex+truncate. Commit 480e820.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix materials panel missing names regression
